slots.label: Input slot
slots.note: field-swappable; options (LivePremier family per RS2 2026 datasheet): HDMI 1.4, HDMI 2.0, DP 1.2/1.4, 8x 3G-SDI, 12G-SDI, NDI+12G-SDI, SFP+, optical, SDVoE, ST 2110

slots.label: Output slot
slots.note: field-swappable; options: HDMI 2.0, DP 1.2/1.4, 12G-SDI, SFP+, optical, SDVoE, ST 2110

notes: Ports = standard card set from datasheet (24 in: 12 HDMI 2.0 + 8 DP 1.2 + 4 12G-SDI; 16 HDMI 2.0 out). Datasheet says 'dual redundancy Ethernet ports with AES67' + native Dante 64x64: split between control and Dante ports not stated, modelled as 2 RJ45. Tally/GPI-O present, count not stated; connector assumed Phoenix (MCO 5-pin plugs supplied with RS2). USB/LTC not listed. Dimensions without rack ears. Max 1010 W, PSU 2+1 hot-swap, inlet type not stated. Card options list taken from RS2 2026 datasheet (same LivePremier platform).
